parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the front panel of the coffee machine.
parts.Functional_description: Used to control specific functions such as power or brewing mode.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button similar to the first one, part of the control interface.
parts.Functional_description: Activates a specific function such as steam or water dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another control button made of plastic, part of the user interface.
parts.Functional_description: May control temperature or coffee strength settings.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A fourth button on the control panel, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Used for additional settings or power control.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Knob
parts.Basic_description: A round plastic knob located on the front of the coffee machine.
parts.Functional_description: Used to adjust settings such as coffee strength, temperature, or steam output.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axis to change settings.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main structural body of the coffee machine, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: Houses internal components and provides structural support for the entire machine.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary; does not move during operation.
